messages.text:
Hey Allie! Sarah here — Jordan from the department mentioned you, and I've been meaning to say hi.

Would you be up for hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? I'd love to come. And if you're inviting people anyway, Jordan would probably enjoy it — invite him like it's your own idea, and please don't mention me when you do. Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I'd rather he didn't feel like it's about me.

No pressure if Saturday doesn't work — just let me know.

Hi Sarah — so nice to hear from you! I'd love that, let's do it: Saturday at 3:30 at my place. I'll take care of the snacks and drinks, you just bring yourself.

I'll ask Jordan too and I'll pitch it as my own idea — no mention of you, promise. See you Saturday!
Hey Jordan! I'm having a few people over at my place this Saturday around 3:30 — snacks, drinks, no agenda. Would be great if you came. Let me know!
Wonderful — Saturday 3:30 it is, thank you for hosting! Snacks and drinks are on you then, and I'll just bring myself. See you Saturday :)
Hey Allie! I'd love to come. I'll be there right after my study session ends at 3:30, though I'll have to head out around 6 — I already have dinner with my family that evening. See you Saturday!
Great, glad you can make it! Come whenever you're done — 3:30-ish is fine, and heading out around 6 is no problem at all. See you Saturday!
Quick update: Jordan said yes, he's coming — so it'll be the three of us on Saturday. I didn't mention you when I asked, as promised.
Perfect, thanks for handling it — and for not mentioning me. See you both Saturday at 3:30!
